stateSemantics.patch: When both previous and next window values are truthy, only non-null nested patch fields overwrite; otherwise the next window replaces it, including null. Queued and committed merge order preserved
stateSemantics.seed: Existing addresses fill only missing fields inside windows truthy in both current and seed, considering pending queue; absent windows are skipped. New addresses enqueue whole seed
stateSemantics.clear: Clear pending batch map and reset committed state immediately; no global scheduler disposal added

querySemantics.mints: Set/filter(Boolean)/sort, joined key; option defaults and polling boolean retained
querySemantics.warm: Only current query data undefined permits cross-query cache warm; fresh noninvalidated query and global mint freshness required; highest dataUpdatedAt wins, first equal timestamp retained
querySemantics.generation: Every nonempty query increments per-hook counter; fetched freshness timestamps always recorded; only latest generation writes fetched patches to store; earlier response still returned
querySemantics.seed: Truthy query data queues a missing-field seed microtask independently of fetch enablement; no auth/readiness gate
querySemantics.readback: readBack=false selects shared empty object; helper equality intentionally compares only24h volumeUSD and priceChangePercent. On change a shallow copy is cached but the first projection is returned; subsequent equal reads return that cached copy
querySemantics.refetch: Committed-store missing24h guard precedes awaited invalidation and refetch
